entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return a helmet. Order number is VF-8675309. Just tell me yes or no, can I return it?
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no issue. The color is not what I expected. The box is unopened. I don't have time for twenty questions, just process the return.
Apologies. I'm pulling up your order now... Okay, I see the Pro-Frame helmet, delivered 36 days ago. One moment while I confirm the policy.

Thank you for your patience. Yes, you are well within the 90-day return window for this item. We can absolutely process that for you. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear; getting the right equipment is a key part of rider safety.

I've just authorized the return. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off. Since the helmet box is unopened, the process will be very quick once we receive it.
Fine. I'll look for the email.
And as you're one of our VIP members, I've gone ahead and added a complimentary expedited shipping voucher to your account for your next purchase. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
The email just came through. No, that's all. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
